## 2. Symbol Analysis

**1. Numerology 9: Nearing the end, completion, dedication, mature wisdom**

**2. Life Path Number 9**

**Solitary, self-entertaining, peaceful, aloof, rich inner world**

People with life path number 9 enjoy tranquility, have a rich inner world, and like to entertain themselves. They can live well alone. They prefer solitude, have a full inner life, and their logic is self-consistent.

They tend to have a higher level of education, possess talents in philosophy and spirituality, think deeply, and have a broad perspective.

Mostly introverted, they are not very skilled at handling complex interpersonal relationships and prefer to be alone. Their social interactions tend to be sparse and solitary, with a scholar’s aloofness.

They are quite picky in social matters, unwilling to associate with those they don’t respect, straightforward in character, and not very tactful in dealing with others.

They make a living through professional skills, think deeply, excel at monetizing knowledge, and are suited for consulting, writing, spiritual healing, knowledge-based paid services, and similar fields. They are well-suited to running a one-person company.

(Why do I resonate so deeply with number 9? Because I am a number 9 person myself.)

![Tarot illustration](https://internal-api-drive-stream.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/authcode/?code=ZWNlNGM4NjljYzU0MDgzMjFmNTgyYTYxZDczOTlkNDRfNGRkYjg4YzYzYmZjOGVkZDBjYThiMThlNTljYzRjMWVfSUQ6NzYxOTIzMzUyOTEzNzk0MTQ0OV8xNzgyMTgxMzg5OjE3ODIyNjc3ODlfVjM)

**3. Belongs to the Earth Element**

**True wisdom is “weighty”**

The Hermit card’s element is **Earth**.

Key point: If it were Air, it would be daydreaming; if Water, it would be sentimental.

But it is **Earth**. **What does Earth represent? Reality, sedimentation, resistance.**

This means the “Lamp of Truth” in the Hermit's hand is not some ethereal mysticism but experience that is as **weighty and solid** as the earth.

**It tells you:** All wisdom needs to be **“grounded.”** Truths not tested by reality are just nonsense.

**It also warns:** This kind of wisdom is gained **“slowly.”** Like a farmer tilling the soil, you must endure loneliness and the feeling of “weight” to reap the harvest. **Those who rush will never light this lamp.**

**4. Astrological Correspondence: Virgo**

The Hermit corresponds to **Virgo**.

Many think Virgos are picky and nitpicky, but on a spiritual level, Virgo is the **“perfect analyst”** and **“selfless devotee.”**

Why does the Hermit’s lamp only illuminate the path at his feet?

This reflects Virgo’s **“concrete precision.”** It does not talk about grand love but solves specific problems at hand.

**Self-renewal:** Virgo excels at “cutting away the dross.” The Hermit’s solitude is actually a “decluttering” of the soul. He strips away all vanity and superficiality (the gray cloak), leaving only the core truth.

**Spirit of service:** Why does he stand on the mountaintop holding the lamp? That is Virgo’s **“service archetype.”** He disciplines himself rigorously and perfectly, not for self-indulgence but to **illuminate the path for the lost.** **This is the highest form of compassion: doing the most altruistic thing with the most rigorous attitude.**

**5. Hebrew Letter: The Open Hand**

When we look at the Wheel of Fortune card, we often only see the wheel turning and people being tossed about. But Yod tells us: **At the center of the wheel (the unmoving hub), there is a “hand.”**

● 

**“Outstretched hand”:** symbolizes divine grace descending (Jupiter’s favor).

● 

**“Clenched hand”:** symbolizes human control over fate (the intervention of will).

## 3. Case Studies

### Wei Dongyi: A Lamp of The Hermit That Refuses to Go Out in the Age of Traffic

If we were to find a “real-life representative” of a Tarot card in the world of 2025, it would definitely be **The Hermit**, and that person is **Wei Dongyi**.

He is not the kind of passive, reclusive “hermit,” but the wise man in the Tarot who **holds a hexagram lamp, stands on a mountaintop, and watches over truth alone.**

#### 1. Rejecting the Noise: This Is Not Aloofness but the Stability of the “Earth Element”

The Hermit card’s element is **Earth**. Earth represents sedimentation and “weight.”

In an era when everyone is scrambling for traffic and eager to slice life into fragments to monetize, Wei Dongyi is like a stone sunk to the bottom of the water. He refuses interviews, closes comment sections, stays away from social media, and even had to open an account to clarify rumors because he couldn’t stand being secretly photographed and slandered.

**He is not “hiding,” he is “guarding.”**

**What he guards is the purity of mathematics.**

Just like the old man on the Hermit card, his gaze is lowered, only looking at the path beneath his feet. In Wei’s world, there are no KPIs, no commercial value, only those difficult math problems. This “anti-traffic” behavior may seem eccentric to outsiders but to insiders, it is **the highest level of defending one’s spiritual domain.**

#### 2. Carrying the Lamp Alone: That Lamp Holds the Wisdom of the “Hexagram”

The lamp in the Hermit’s hand contains a **hexagram**, symbolizing sacred wisdom and guidance.

What is the “lamp” in Wei’s hand? Is it the 1.5-liter bottle of mineral water? The bag of steamed buns? No, it is **mathematics.**

His lamp does not shine far ahead but only illuminates the ground beneath his feet. He does not pursue worldly “success” nor care about material scarcity (earning 600,000 yuan a year but spending only 300 yuan a month). His spiritual world is as rich as a starry sky; material things are merely fuel for survival.

**A true Hermit is rich inside.**

He dialogues with Euler and Gauss in the universe of mathematics, a joy far surpassing the applause in a livestream.

#### 3. The Compassion of the Sweeping Monk: Unwilling to Teach, Yet Becoming a Lighthouse

The Hermit card represents not only solitude but also **the spirit of service** (corresponding to Virgo).

Though Wei is taciturn, he has not made himself an island. He still teaches at Peking University, mentors students, and publishes top-level papers (such as “Mathematical Study of Fluid Transition Mechanisms”).

**He has never actively preached, but his existence itself is a revelation.**

When countless netizens treat him as a “God of Exams” in comment sections, when young people believe in the power of “pure passion” because of him, **he has already become a lighthouse.**

This subtle influence is more powerful than any high-profile speech. He shows the world through action: **You can choose not to be bound by worldly standards; you can live as an island for what you love.**

#### 4. Conclusion: Be Your Own Lamp Bearer in the Flood of Algorithms

The Wei Dongyi phenomenon is actually a collective projection of the “Hermit spirit” by the public.

In this era of algorithmic recommendations and entertainment to death, we are swept forward, anxious, exhausted, and confused. Wei’s appearance is like a fresh stream, showing us another way to live:

**You can be quiet but deep.**

**You can refuse to conform but hold firm.**

The Hermit card tells us: **True wisdom hides in deep tranquility.**

Wei carries that lamp of mathematics, walking alone in the noisy age of traffic.

He does not illuminate the whole world, only those willing to seek truth in the dark.

**This is the highest interpretation of the Hermit card: enduring loneliness, guarding the light within.**
